title: Print message
description: Print a message to standard output.
explanation: Print a message to standard output.
usage: Use this when you need to print a message to standard output.
mistakes: Never put user input in the printf format string; this example uses a fixed %s format.

title: Integer variable
description: Declare and print an integer.
explanation: Declare and print an integer.
usage: Use this when you need to declare and print an integer.
mistakes: Use the correct printf conversion specifier for the value type.

title: Floating point
description: Print a decimal number to two places.
explanation: Print a decimal number to two places.
usage: Use this when you need to print a decimal number to two places.
mistakes: Use %f for a double in printf and choose an explicit precision.

title: Character
description: Store and print a single character.
explanation: Store and print a single character.
usage: Use this when you need to store and print a single character.
mistakes: A character uses single quotes; a string uses double quotes.

title: Condition
code:
int score = 82;
if (score >= 60) { puts("Passed"); } else { puts("Try again"); }
description: Choose a branch based on a score.
explanation: Choose a branch based on a score.
usage: Use this when you need to choose a branch based on a score.
mistakes: C has no built-in string equality; this condition uses integers.

title: For loop
code: for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { printf("%d\n", i); }
description: Repeat a statement with a counter.
explanation: Repeat a statement with a counter.
usage: Use this when you need to repeat a statement with a counter.
mistakes: The loop stops before the upper bound.

title: While loop
description: Repeat while a condition is true.
explanation: Repeat while a condition is true.
usage: Use this when you need to repeat while a condition is true.
mistakes: Increment the counter to avoid an infinite loop.

title: Array
description: Store and access a fixed sequence.
explanation: Store and access a fixed sequence.
usage: Use this when you need to store and access a fixed sequence.
mistakes: C does not check array bounds for you.

title: Array length
description: Calculate the length of a local array.
explanation: Calculate the length of a local array.
usage: Use this when you need to calculate the length of a local array.
mistakes: sizeof computes array length only here, not after decay to a function pointer.

title: String
description: Store a null-terminated string.
explanation: Store a null-terminated string.
usage: Use this when you need to store a null-terminated string.
mistakes: Leave space for the terminating null character when copying strings.

title: Read integer
description: Read an integer and check conversion success.
explanation: Read an integer and check conversion success.
usage: Use this when you need to read an integer and check conversion success.
mistakes: Check scanf's return value and pass the address with &.

title: Read line
code:
char line[100];
if (fgets(line, sizeof line, stdin)) { printf("%s", line); }
description: Read bounded text input.
explanation: Read bounded text input.
usage: Use this when you need to read bounded text input.
mistakes: fgets needs the full buffer capacity and may keep the trailing newline.

title: Function
description: Define a reusable function before main.
explanation: Define a reusable function before main.
usage: Use this when you need to define a reusable function before main.
mistakes: Define the function before main or declare a prototype first.

title: Pointer
description: Access a value through its address.
explanation: Access a value through its address.
usage: Use this when you need to access a value through its address.
mistakes: Do not dereference NULL, an uninitialized pointer, or an expired local address.

title: Pointer parameter
description: Modify a caller value through a pointer.
explanation: Modify a caller value through a pointer.
usage: Use this when you need to modify a caller value through a pointer.
mistakes: Check for NULL and use a pointer to an object that is still alive.

title: String length
description: Measure the length of a string.
explanation: Measure the length of a string.
usage: Use this when you need to measure the length of a string.
mistakes: strlen excludes the terminating null byte and needs a valid terminated string.

title: String comparison
description: Compare string contents.
explanation: Compare string contents.
usage: Use this when you need to compare string contents.
mistakes: strcmp returns zero for equality; == compares addresses.

title: Struct
description: Define a record of related values.
explanation: Define a record of related values.
usage: Use this when you need to define a record of related values.
mistakes: A struct definition ends with a semicolon.

title: Struct instance
code:
struct { const char *name; int score; } student = {"Alex", 92};
printf("%s: %d\n", student.name, student.score);
description: Initialize and read a structured record.
explanation: Initialize and read a structured record.
usage: Use this when you need to initialize and read a structured record.
mistakes: Initializer values must match field order and compatible types.

title: Allocate memory
description: Allocate checked heap memory and release it.
explanation: Allocate checked heap memory and release it.
usage: Use this when you need to allocate checked heap memory and release it.
mistakes: Check malloc before use and pair each allocation with one free.

title: Read file
description: Read a text file line by line.
explanation: Read a text file line by line.
usage: Use this when you need to read a text file line by line.
mistakes: Check fopen before reading and close the stream afterward.

title: Write file
description: Write text and close the file.
explanation: Write text and close the file.
usage: Use this when you need to write text and close the file.
mistakes: Opening with w truncates an existing file.

title: Enum
description: Define named integer constants.
explanation: Define named integer constants.
usage: Use this when you need to define named integer constants.
mistakes: Enum constants are integers and do not automatically convert to strings.

title: Switch
description: Choose among discrete cases.
explanation: Choose among discrete cases.
usage: Use this when you need to choose among discrete cases.
mistakes: Without break, execution falls through to the next case.

title: Zeroed allocation
description: Allocate zero-initialized memory.
explanation: Allocate zero-initialized memory.
usage: Use this when you need to allocate zero-initialized memory.
mistakes: calloc initializes allocated bytes to zero; still check for failure.

title: Constant
description: Protect a value from reassignment.
explanation: Protect a value from reassignment.
usage: Use this when you need to protect a value from reassignment.
mistakes: const prevents modification through this binding.

title: Complete average
description: Calculate the average of an array.
explanation: Calculate the average of an array.
usage: Use this when you need to calculate the average of an array.
mistakes: Use a floating-point cast before division and avoid dividing by an empty length.
